related.title: E3SM：模擬年每日、時間邊界與科學通過率
related.titleEn: E3SM: simulated years per day, timing boundaries and scientific qualification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：數值、日曆與覆蓋政策共同構成可比較結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A comparable result includes the value, calendar and coverage policy together.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「E3SM：模擬年每日、時間邊界與科學通過率」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付模擬日曆、時間邊界圖、SYPD 與每年成本，以及科學驗收表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate E3SM: simulated years per day, timing boundaries and scientific qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the simulation calendar, timing-boundary diagram, SYPD and per-year cost calculations plus a scientific acceptance table preserving failed fast configurations as evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計分子 310+560+1240 與九十天分母；和月等權平均比較，保留差異理由。
43200 秒換半天，算五除半；另求每年 8640 秒，再反算每日可完成年數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate numerator 310+560+1240 and denominator ninety days. Compare with an equal-month average and explain how differing month lengths change the result even when no data is missing.
Convert 43200 seconds to half a day and divide five by that duration. Independently compute 8640 wall seconds per simulated year and invert it to recover throughput, checking units at each step.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OSU Micro-Benchmarks：往返平均與單向延遲語義
related.titleEn: OSU Micro-Benchmarks: round-trip averages and one-way semantics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：數值、日曆與覆蓋政策共同構成可比較結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A comparable result includes the value, calendar and coverage policy together.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「OSU Micro-Benchmarks：往返平均與單向延遲語義」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付ping-pong事件表、warmup分界、配置與資料校驗結果；報告寫平均半往返估計，不把它冒充純網路傳播或尾延遲。
related.differenceEn: Investigate OSU Micro-Benchmarks: round-trip averages and one-way semantics using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a ping-pong event ledger, warmup boundary, configuration and payload checks. Label the number as an average half-round-trip estimate rather than pure propagation delay or a tail-latency percentile.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計分子 310+560+1240 與九十天分母；和月等權平均比較，保留差異理由。
先以一次往返12微秒畫時間線，得到平均6；再將100次總1200微秒計算，與錯誤1200/100並列，說明兩者分別回答什麼。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate numerator 310+560+1240 and denominator ninety days. Compare with an equal-month average and explain how differing month lengths change the result even when no data is missing.

Draw a single twelve-microsecond round trip to obtain a six-microsecond half-trip average. Extend the reasoning to one hundred trips totaling 1200 microseconds, and contrast division by one hundred with division by two hundred without conflating the resulting quantities.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
